summary: Backend regression and mobile-web UI validation run completed. Backend critical flows passed; frontend has key passes with unresolved interaction regressions.

ui_bugs.issue: Multiple elements with same testIDs are present in DOM; first resolved nodes are often non-visible, causing add tap failures in automation and unstable interaction targeting.
Console repeatedly reports 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>'.

integration_issues.flow: Cart celebration popup from Home add
integration_issues.issue: Popup could not be reliably triggered because visible Home add button could not be found/clicked in current DOM state during retests.
Measured category card columns intermittently show extra lane due to duplicate mounted screen nodes, making deterministic 2-column assertion unreliable.

react_native_issues.issue: Raw text node appears directly under View (RN web warning), needs source component cleanup to avoid runtime warnings and potential native red-screen risk.

action_items: Fix duplicate mounted-screen/testID collision behavior so visible node targeting is deterministic.
Resolve 'Unexpected text node under <View>' warning by wrapping all literal text in <Text> and removing stray text nodes.
Re-test cart popup trigger from Home/category/detail after interaction stability fix.
Re-run focused verification for addresses CRUD and checkout payment modal after selector/visibility stabilization.
critical_code_review_comments: AppShell/back behavior is implemented correctly for Home vs opened pages, but retained mounted screens produce duplicate testIDs and brittle interaction resolution.
Category layout itself appears styled for 2-column beside sidebar, but duplicate DOM layers can distort measured column counts in runtime checks.
Backend order model correctly enforces payment_method enum and persists payment_status='not_charged'; support receipt persistence is verified directly in MongoDB.

success_rate.frontend: 62% (core flows partially passed; multiple unresolved interaction checks)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ support requests and sample orders during automated testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use visible-node evaluation or stricter scoped selectors due duplicate mounted nodes. Validate cart popup from all three sources after UI stabilization. Re-check account/address/payment flows end-to-end without page reload dependency.
rca_of_issue: RCA: UI tree retains multiple route instances with identical testIDs, so locator-first often binds hidden/offscreen nodes. This caused false-negative click failures (element not visible) and unstable column/popup assertions. Additional RN warning indicates at least one stray text node directly inside View, which should be corrected for RN compliance.
